title: Zesty Roasted Russian Pork Dumplings
description: Indulgent Russian dish featuring ground pork and pasta water emulsion, roasted to perfection with a snappy texture, FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, pasta water, chopped onion, garlic infused oil, salt, black pepper, paprika, and Russian spice blend.
Mix all the ingredients together until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small dumplings, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling.
Roast the dumplings in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are cooked through and lightly browned on the outside.
Remove the dumplings from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes on the baking sheet.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
